verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document enterprise identity authentication (SSO, SAML, OIDC) or cloud-platform identity integration such as IAM-based access to a cloud model platform. The only related material is BYOK with your own provider API keys (cline-docs-42) and a sign-in-once Cline credits provider (cline-docs-43). These are adjacent credential-management features and do not deliver enterprise or cloud-platform authentication for compliance.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
